limitations: Task-local prototype only; it does not change the selected canonical authority, catalog entry, approval state, or training admission.
marker_anchor=top_left is the exact base canonical Racket source after stripping outer whitespace.
Only top_left and bottom_right vary; marker color, object selection, tight crop, zero canvas, and nonzero paste behavior remain fixed.
Every retained input is a lawful draw from the selected production generator, both anchors fit, and the two settings produce different outputs.
Evidence covers one episode per setting, 2-6 demonstrations, exactly four distinct queries, and the single declared rival.
Finite pairwise evidence does not prove uniqueness against arbitrary ARC programs or behavior outside the parent-generator domain.

dependent_input_constraints: input passes the selected production generator self_check
both declared anchor placements fit fully in bounds
the two declared settings produce different outputs on every retained input
invariant_reasoning_steps: collect every nonzero non-maroon object cell
crop those cells to their tight bounding box
paste nonzero crop cells on a fresh zero canvas
parameter_contract.name: marker_anchor
parameter_contract.sampling_unit: once per episode from a rule-only deterministic seed stream
